caveats: S4 family: original 360/400 acquisition duty; once-only six 8 ms retry sectors after two 22.5 ms expiries. Edge cancellation depends on variant below. Closed floor holds 360 to 150 ms then fades to minimum by 450 ms. Native missing-feedback count includes all retries. Bench only.
S4B/S4C seed the ADC handoff guard with the latest real adjacent interval, not the IIR. IIR, first commutation delay and early-pulse rejection are unchanged.

S4D/S4D-LOG keep only the remaining short-sector budget after a solitary edge during rescue. Both edges and timeouts consume sectors; a second consecutive edge cancels the remainder. No refund, new attempt or acquisition extension.
Software-consumed sequential ADC data, not simultaneous scope measurements or rotor direction.

S4E overrides short-sector waiting after a real edge: 22.5 ms feedback window, expiry consumes budget and resumes remaining 8 ms sectors. One-second observation freezes diagnostics, NOT the motor. Later loss still stops drive but may have no waveform; final summary reason can differ from the frozen observation. Not flight-validated.
100 us tail freezes on first acquisition timeout after accepted feedback, or handoff. No-edge trials retain tail; first-edge exact fields retained.
Tail only: 256 samples spaced >=100 us; 96 events include every accepted ADC sample until overwritten. No guarantee of full startup history.
Missing fresh samples may leave gaps; inspect actual timestamps, counts and event overwrite. Software direction flags are commands, not measured rotor direction.
First no-lock, first post-handoff loss and first full observation are pinned independently; operator-zero and safety stops remain unpinned. Last 16 trial summaries are separate.
PWM/trigger fields read preload registers at consumption, not latched compare values at ADC trigger. Gate/ADC pin analog correctness needs external measurement if software traces remain ambiguous.
Cycle maxima measure inner logger only, not full ISR. No physical protection/flight validation.
Last 16 summaries. S3-D retains separate first no-lock, first post-handoff loss and first complete observation tails. Operator zero and other stops are not pinned.
Observed times are service timestamps, not physical zero-cross timestamps. Current is a filtered software maximum, not peak phase current.

S4E: 300 ms acquisition STOP remains. After handoff, motor has NO one-second stop. Metrics freeze at one-second observation; elapsed/current/counters are NOT full-run totals. Summary final reason reflects eventual stop, possibly later than the stored metrics. First runtime timeout still stops drive.

S3 family (including S4): event-led acquisition <= 300 ms; streak counts consecutive ADC-qualified edges, NOT S2 phase-window qualification. Six edges earn <= 1 s observation; first runtime timeout aborts. Not a native stuck-trip proof or flight mode.
